# Transmission and transfer case problems

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Compare the input shaft of a known good transmission to the suspect unit, then inspect their material compositions. [t2127]

[Partial] Drain the transmission fluid completely, then fill it with Valvoline Max Life ATF. [t1347]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. [Partial] Compare the input shaft of a known good transmission to the suspect unit.
2. [Partial] Inspect the material composition of both shafts.

_Procedure reported by [t2127]._

<details><summary>Alternate procedure [t1347] [Partial]</summary>

1. [Partial] Drain the transmission fluid completely.
2. [Partial] Fill it with Valvoline Max Life ATF until full.

</details>

## Parts

- Valvoline Max Life ATF [t1347]

## Tips & gotchas

- Allow time for the new fluid to circulate and mix with what remains in the transmission. [t1347]
